name: environaut
description: Chrome extension that shows which environment a tab is on and jumps the same page between dev, stage and prod.

scripts.build: npm run icons && npm run typecheck && npm test && vite build && vite build --config vite.config.content.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../environaut.zip . -x '*.map'
